from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-ab2b9437.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The colored run across the top defines vertical rays; matching isolated
    # colors provide endpoints that turn each ray into an L.
    motif = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0]
    motif_cols = {c for c, _ in motif}
    for c, color in motif:
        anchors = [(r, x) for r in range(h) for x in range(w)
                   if grid[r][x] == color and not (r == 0 and x in motif_cols)]
        if not anchors:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][c] = color
            continue
        for r, x in anchors:
            for rr in range(min(r, 0), max(r, 0) + 1):
                out[rr][c] = color
            for xx in range(min(c, x), max(c, x) + 1):
                out[r][xx] = color
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path)
